camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeParameterGroupTemplateList --region cn-hangzhou --Category standard --EngineVersion '5.0' --EngineType redis --CharacterType db
description_en: Queries the information about the parameters that can be configured in a parameter template, such as the default values, value ranges, and descriptions
description_zh: 查询参数模板中可配置参数的具体信息，例如默认值、取值范围、描述等
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-parameter-group-template-list --category standard --engine-version 5.0 --engine-type redis --character-type db --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeParameterGroupTemplateList

parameters.help_en:
The service category. Valid values:

standard: Redis Open-Source Edition
enterprise: Tair (Enterprise Edition)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类别，取值：
standard：Redis开源版
enterprise：Tair（企业版）
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The compatible engine version. Valid values:

For Redis Open-Source Edition instances, set the parameter to 5.0, 6.0, or 7.0.
For Tair DRAM-based instances that are compatible with Redis 5.0, 6.0, or 7.0, set the parameter to 5.0, 6.0, or 7.0.
For Tair persistent memory-optimized instances that are compatible with Redis 6.0, set the parameter to 1.0.
For Tair ESSD-based instances that are compatible with Redis 6.0, set the parameter to 1.0. For Tair SSD-based instances that are compatible with Redis 6.0, set the parameter to 2.0
parameters.help_zh:
兼容版本，取值：
Redis开源版支持5.0、6.0和7.0。
Tair内存型兼容 Redis 5.0、6.0和7.0协议，传5.0、6.0或7.0。
Tair持久内存型兼容Redis 6.0协议，传1.0。
Tair 磁盘（ESSD/SSD）兼容 Redis 6.0 协议。 创建ESSD型的参数模板请传入1.0、创建SSD型的参数模板请传入2.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The engine type. Valid values:

redis: Redis Open-Source Edition or Tair (In-Memory)
tair_pena: Tair (On NVM)
tair_pdb: Tair (On Disk)
parameters.help_zh:
引擎类型，取值：
redis：Redis开源版或Tair内存型
tair_pena：Tair持久内存型
tair_pdb：Tair 磁盘型（ESSD/SSD）
parameters.name: engine_type

parameters.help_en: The role of the instance. Valid values: logic: logical instance. db: database instance. proxy: proxy node. cs: ConfigServer node. normal: master-replica database instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例的角色类型，取值说明：
logic：集群逻辑实例
db：集群DB实例
proxy：集群Proxy实例
cs：集群CS实例
normal：主备DB实例
parameters.name: character_type
